node.title: Re: File::Find options to ignore NFS mounts
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [hrisheekesh_kale],

See [id://1161756] for how to restrict [mod://File::Find] to the filesystem(s) on which the search began. You can also implement your own logic and use the $File::Find::topdev variable in other ways, such as exclude certain filesystems from the search. To get the device number of a path, try this: perl -le 'print +(stat("/tmp"))[0]'

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
